items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: Nellie Lutcher joined my band then. She was the pianist in our band.

ctx.x: I'm telling you about myself. Well I left here with Paul Barnes. I think he's still playing. He's in Chicago now. He left here. Me and his brother. We formed a band and we traveled. Yeah, he was all signed. I got a card. Yeah, he got a card for him. And then we organized a seven piece band. Well then we traveled all around up to Lake Charles. There where we, Nellie Lutcher joined my band then. She was the pianist in our band. That's before I had married Willie, before I met Willie. And I traveled all over part of…
Mm-hmm. Did you ever run across Lawrence Dewey out there in that part of the country around Lafayette or New Iberia?

items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Nellie Lutcher in their response; the name is only mentioned by the interviewer in a question that the interviewee does not directly address or confirm knowledge of.

ctx.x: I don't know if it's just about the first record or not.
Who was the piano player with Paul Barnes on the time? He wasn't. He wasn't.

Nellie Lutcher? Yes, a year ago. She was out in the Charles. Did you ever work with Don Alba? Yeah, I went off on a month or two. Was that before Paul Barnes or after? It was almost during the time. I think we had split up and Don Alba was short with trumpet playing. I left Frank Charles and made a trip with him. Through Texas, we were joined with Don Alba. During that time, he made a trip to see his mother and father. He hadn't seen in a couple of years. So I rode back in the car with him, made my people visit,…
